newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 2.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Riyadh governor orders 4.4 million riyals in aide to Bosnia to help build houses.
- Saudi Cable Company raises its capital to 500 million riyals from 300 million.
- Saudi Arabia offers 140 million riyals to famine victims in Somalia.
- Around 126 million shares worth 21 billion riyals were traded in Saudi Arabia in the first half of 1997.
- Saudi Basic Industries Corporation (SABIC) signs a 338 million riyal agreement to build a berth at Yanbu port.
